evidence.title: Start of Malaysian F1 race delayed by huge downpour
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Rain began to fall 45 minutes before the scheduled start of F1’s first race at Sepang in nine years, intensifying to completely soak the track and the assembled teams and drivers on the starting grid. [e002:f02] The race start was inevitably delayed due to far too much standing water on the track for the race to begin. [e002:f03] There was also thunder and lightning in the distance. [e002:f04] The medical car completed laps of the track around the time of the initial planned start time and quickly reported the track conditions weren't suitable for racing. [e002:f05] The 10-minute signal was issued half an hour after the initial start time, with the formation lap scheduled for 4.40pm local time. [e002:f06] The FIA's weather radar went down 15 minutes before the start of the initial start time, before coming back online around 25 minutes later. [e002:f07] This will be a huge step into the unknown for all the 2026 F1 drivers, as it will be the first properly rain-affected session of the new regulations. [e002:f08] “[It will be] a good test for the regulations also because I think with all the issues we have with downshifts, with harvesting, power, variability, corner to corner, the wet is going to be a challenge, for sure,” Sainz said on the prospect of rain ahead of the weekend. [e002:f09] “Both from a tyre standpoint, from what I heard, this year's wet tyres and intermediate tyres, it’s quite a difficult tyre for people that have run it, plus the power unit factor.” Some teams have already got a taste of the intermediate and wet tyres during private Pirelli tests. [e002:f10] Pierre Gasly, who took part in a wet tyre test for Pirelli after the Miami GP, said of the first wet 2026 F1 race, he “wouldn't be surprised if we end up having a bit of an elimination game”. [e002:f11] Advertisement 00:00。

耐久レース「黄金時代」へ…FIAとACO、WECを2037年末まで10年延長で合意
evidence.body: [e003:f01] 国際自動車連盟（FIA）とフランス西部自動車クラブ（ACO）は、FIA世界耐久選手権（FIA WEC）に関する重要な合意に達したと発表した。 [e003:f02] 今回の合意により、FIA WECは今後10年間にわたる成長への基盤を確保するとしている。 [e003:f03] 新たな契約期間は、現行契約が満了する2027年末から2037年末まで。 [e003:f04] 今回は2025年7月以降にFIAが締結した4件目の長期的なFIA世界選手権関連合意となる。 [e003:f05] ◆規則策定・監督体制を強化 延長されたパートナーシップのもとでは、すべての競技規則に関するプロセスがFIAワーキンググループおよびFIA耐久委員会によって監督され、最終的にはFIA世界モータースポーツ評議会の承認が必要となる。 [e003:f06] ホモロゲーション（公認）プロセスも簡素化され、ハイパーカークラスのすべてのマシンについてFIAとACOが共同で監督する体制となる。 [e003:f07] また、パルクフェルメ、表彰台、セーフティカーをはじめとする主要エリアへのFIAロゴ掲出や、テレビ放送コンテンツにおけるFIAブランドの露出も大幅に強化される。 [e003:f08] ◆観客数8％増、44％が34歳以下 FIA WECは現在、「黄金時代」を迎えているとされる。 [e003:f09] 2026年シーズンのサーキット観客数は現時点で8％増加しており、世界中で数百万人のファンが選手権を追いかけている。 [e003:f10] 今年の観客の44％が34歳以下で、40％がFIA WECを初めて現地観戦するファンだ。 [e003:f11] 現在、世界を代表する自動車メーカー8社がハイパーカークラスに参戦しており、2024年に加わったLMGT3クラスを含めると合計14ブランドがグリッドに並ぶ。 [e003:f12] ◆2030年から共通技術規定を導入 今回の合意では、FIA WECと北米のIMSAの双方で参戦するハイパーカーについて、より統一された技術的枠組みを2030年から導入することも盛り込まれた。 [e003:f13] さらに、競技における水素パワートレインの開発を推進するための枠組みも構築し、より持続可能なモビリティ社会の実現に向けた道筋を示す。 [e003:f14] FIA会長のモハメド・ベン・スレイエム氏は「これは未来のために結ばれた合意であり、まさに“世紀の契約”ともいえるものだ。 [e003:f15] 120年以上にわたるFIAとACOの協力関係をさらに強固なものとし、ファン、ドライバー、チーム、そして自動車メーカーに真の利益をもたらす、過去最高の成長を遂げる10年間に向けて選手権を新たなステージへと導くものだ」と述べた。 [e003:f16] ACO会長のピエール・フィヨン氏は「このパートナーシップは、信頼、共通の目標、そして耐久レースの発展に対する揺るぎない共通の決意によって築かれてきた。

evidence.title: ルクレール最速も序列は見えず。アロンソ再び好走、アストン最下位争いから前進 / F1バーレーンGP 2026《FP2》結果と詳報
evidence.body: [e004:f01] アロンソ再び好走、アストン最下位争いから前進 / F1バーレーンGP 2026《FP2》結果と詳報 Published： 2026/10/2 18:32 2026年F1第16戦バーレーンGPのフリー走行2回目（FP2）が10月2日（金）、マレーシアのセパン・インターナショナル・サーキットで行われ、シャルル・ルクレール（フェラーリ）がアイザック・ハジャー（レッドブル）をわずか0.099秒差で抑えてトップに立った。 [e004:f02] レッドブルのマックス・フェルスタッペンは、チームメイトに0.158秒差の4番手にとどまったが、こちらは上位勢とは異なりソフトタイヤを一度も履かず、ミディアムタイヤで計測ラップを走った。 [e004:f03] フリー走行1回目（FP1）で2台ともトップ10圏外に沈んだマクラーレン勢が上位に戻った一方、メルセデスは2台ともソフトタイヤでのアタックをまとめることができず、タイムシート上位を逃した。 [e004:f04] 事前には降水確率90％と予想されていたが、懸念された雨は降らず、各車はドライコンディションで周回を重ねた。 [e004:f05] Here's the weather radar 👀 #F1 #BahrainGP — Formula 1 (@F1) October 2, 2026 マクラーレン浮上もメルセデスは不発 ルクレールのチームメイト、ルイス・ハミルトンは5番手につけた。 [e004:f06] 残り33分、アタック中のガブリエル・ボルトレート（アウディ）がターン9に向かっていたところ、ハミルトンがレーシングライン上を低速で走行。 [e004:f07] 大規模なアップグレードを投入したメルセデス勢は、ジョージ・ラッセルが7番手、アンドレア・キミ・アントネッリが8番手にとどまった。 [e004:f08] 両者ともソフトタイヤで自己ベストを更新できず、ラッセルはアタック終盤の最終コーナー進入でロックアップした。 [e004:f09] ローソン中団最上位、ボルトレート停止でVSC コンストラクターズ選手権5位を争うレーシング・ブルズとアルピーヌでは、リアム・ローソンがピエール・ガスリーをわずか0.092秒差で上回り、中団最上位の9番手を記録した。 [e004:f10] 前戦での接触に対する処分とパワーユニット（PU）交換に伴い、決勝では計15グリッド降格を受けるため、決勝を重視した走行プログラムだった可能性もある。 [e004:f11] Lindblad ⚔️ Bortoleto 😮 #F1 #BahrainGP — Formula 1 (@F1) October 2, 2026 最終的にはボルトレートがリンブラッドをオーバーテイクし、ペースの優位をうかがわせた。 [e004:f12] アストンマーティン・ホンダ、最下位争いから前進 アストンマーティン・ホンダのフェルナンド・アロンソは、14番手だったFP1に続いて中団争いに加わり、FP2では15番手を記録した。 [e004:f13] セパンでは過去に通算3勝、2回のポールポジションを獲得している。 [e004:f14] それでも、最下位争いが続いていた直近数戦を踏まえれば、アストンマーティン・ホンダの初日には明らかに一定の前進が見られた。 [e004:f15] 3回目のフリー走行は、日本時間10月3日(土)13時30分から1時間の日程で開催される。 [e004:f16] 2026年F1第16戦 バーレーンGP フリー走行2（FP2）リザルト Pos No Driver Team Time Gap Laps 1 evidence.body: [e005:f01] 決勝は日本時間16時（現地時間15時）にスタートする予定だったが、約45分前から雨が降り始め、その後さらに雨脚が強まった。 [e005:f02] コース上には大量のスタンディングウォーターが発生し、安全にレースを開始できない状況となった。 [e005:f03] セパン周辺では、遠方で雷鳴や稲妻も確認された。 [e005:f04] ■FIA、メディカルカーで路面状況を確認 FIAは予定されていたスタート時刻の時点で、今後10分程度は天候の改善が見込まれないと判断。 [e005:f05] 路面状況を確認するため、メディカルカーをコースへ送り出した。 [e005:f06] メディカルカーによる確認でも大量のスタンディングウォーターが残っており、その時点ではレースを開始できるコンディションではないと判断された。 [e005:f07] スタート予定時刻から約30分が経過したところで、現地時間15時40分（日本時間16時40分）にフォーメーションラップを開始すると発表された。 [e005:f08] これを受け、ドライバーたちは急いでガレージからグリッドへ戻り、レース開始に向けた準備を進めている。 [e005:f09] フォーメーションラップはセーフティカー先導で開始される。 [e005:f10] ウォルフ代表も驚き「ここまで裏目に出たことは、これまで一度もない」 【ハースF1】小松礼雄代表、オコン放出は「全体像」で判断 後任ルーキー説が強まる 速さだけでは勝てない灼熱セパン、決勝は混戦か 鍵を握るのは「異常な」タイヤ消耗／F1バーレーンGP in マレーシア 最新ニュースをもっと見る » ホンダF1関連記事 » 【アストンマーティン・ホンダ】今季初の2台Q2進出 クラックが分析「低グリップで勢力図が少し変化」／F1バーレーンGP in マレーシア予選 【アストンマーティン・ホンダ】ストロールQ2進出！ [e005:f11] 「今季最も競争力あり」もミスを悔やむ／F1バーレーンGP in マレーシア予選 【アストンマーティン・ホンダ】アロンソ今季最高12番手！ [e005:f12] トップと1.5秒差は最小「セパンはマシンに合っている」ストレートの課題は残る／F1バーレーンGP in マレーシア予選 ホンダF1関連記事を見る » 最新ニュース LIVE 日程 ポイント F1チーム ホンダ アストンマーティン レッドブル フェラーリ すべて開く メルセデス マクラーレン レーシングブルズ アルピーヌ TGRハース アウディ ウィリアムズ キャデラック F1ドライバー 14 アロンソ 18 ストロール 22 角田裕毅 3 フェルスタッペン すべて開く 63 ラッセル 12 アントネッリ 16 ルクレール 44 ハミルトン 1 ノリス 81 ピアストリ 6 ハジャー 30 ローソン 41 リンドブラッド 10 ガスリー 43 コラピント 31 オコン 87 ベアマン 27 ヒュルケンベルグ 5 ボルトレト 55 サインツ 23 アルボン 11 ペレス 77 ボッタス 40 岩佐歩夢。

evidence.title: Aston Martin will be delaying its maiden EV launch to 2033 or later
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Aston Martin is delaying the arrival of its first EV up to 2033 since the brand only needs to have battery-electric vehicles ready to meet regulatory requirements in certain markets shortly before 2035. [e001:f02] New Delhi: Aston Martin has pushed back the introduction of its first fully electric model once again. [e001:f03] The brand is now looking at a launch sometime between 2033 and 2035. [e001:f04] Speaking to Autocar UK, Hallmark described Aston Martin as a “BEV delayer” rather than a “BEV denier” and said the brand will remain predominantly focused on internal-combustion engines until 2035. [e001:f05] Aston Martin has revised its EV timeline several times. [e001:f06] The brand originally planned to introduce its first electric car in 2025 before shifting the target to 2026 and later suggesting that the model would arrive by 2030. [e001:f07] As per him, both areas are making quicker faster than automakers can easily adapt to, making it difficult for Aston Martin to commit to a specific launch date. [e001:f08] Lucid technology to underpin future EVs Aston Martin has an agreement with Lucid for electric-vehicle technology, while it also maintains a relationship with Mercedes-Benz, its current engine technology partner. [e001:f09] The delayed EV programme means Aston Martin can spend more time assessing how battery and electric powertrain technology develops before committing significant funds to production. [e001:f10] Hallmark said the technology Aston Martin will eventually receive from Lucid is likely to be substantially different from what was originally agreed when the partnership was signed. [e001:f11] For now, Aston Martin’s spending on its EV programme remains relatively limited, with the company concentrating on research and evaluation rather than large-scale investment. [e001:f12] Aston Martin is also preparing to keep its combustion engines alive well into the next decade. [e001:f13] This carries on with the strategy outlined by Stroll in 2024, when he said Aston Martin intended to continue producing ICE-powered cars for as long as regulations permitted. [e001:f14] Hallmark also said Aston Martin expects its entire product range to be replaced between 2030 and 2035. [e001:f15] He even confirmed that Aston Martin is investing in the Valhalla platform for future low-volume special editions. [e001:f16] Aston Martin’s previous attempt at launching a production EV was the Rapide E.

evidence.title: Hamilton learns fate after FIA investigates Bortoleto incident in FP2
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The FIA has announced the outcome of its investigation into Lewis Hamilton after the Ferrari driver impeded Gabriel Bortoleto during FP2 for the Bahrain Grand Prix at Sepang. [e002:f02] FIA reaches verdict on Hamilton following Bortoleto impeding incident in FP2 Photo: Race Pictures Breaking News Updated : 14:39, 02 Oct 43 Comments Tobia Elia Tobia is a Formula 1 journalist at GPblog with experience at international circuits. [e002:f03] Since 2022, he has covered Grands Prix across Europe, delivering reliable coverage and insights from the paddock. [e002:f04] The incident occurred during the latter stages of FP2, when Hamilton found himself in Bortoleto’s path as the Audi driver approached at considerable speed. [e002:f05] With the Ferrari travelling slowly ahead, Bortoleto had little choice but to take evasive action and move towards the left-hand side of the circuit to prevent a collision. [e002:f06] Bortoleto was particularly frustrated by the fact that Hamilton appeared to have seen him coming but did not clear the racing line in time. [e002:f07] However, after reviewing the incident and taking into account that it took place during a practice session, the FIA opted against handing the Ferrari driver a severe penalty. [e002:f08] Hamilton escaped with a warning, meaning no further sporting punishment was imposed on the seven-time world champion. [e002:f09] Ferrari were not entirely spared, however, with the team receiving a €10,000 fine in connection with the incident. [e002:f10] Photo: Race Pictures ADVERTISEMENT FIA stewards reveal reasoning behind Hamilton’s Bortoleto verdict In their explanation, the stewards stated that Hamilton was responsible for the incident, having moved onto the racing line at low speed and unnecessarily impeded Bortoleto as the Audi driver approached at a significantly higher speed. [e002:f11] They also took into account several mitigating circumstances, including the damage to Hamilton’s right-hand mirror, the absence of a warning from Ferrari over the radio and the fact that Bortoleto was not completing a push lap. [e002:f12] The stewards also examined the possibility of treating the incident as dangerous impeding due to the large speed difference, but Bortoleto was able to react in time and avoid contact. [e002:f13] With those circumstances taken into account, Hamilton was handed a warning, in line with the usual penalty for an impeding offence during practice. [e002:f14] The stewards noted that the team knew about the damage to Hamilton’s right-hand mirror and therefore should have warned him about faster cars approaching from behind. [e002:f15] That obligation applied regardless of whether the approaching driver was completing a push lap, particularly because Hamilton’s visibility of the traffic behind him had been compromised. [e002:f16] ADVERTISEMENT Read also Verstappen sees encouraging signs after FP2 but refuses to get carried away Vasseur sets the record straight on his Ferrari relationship after media frenzy Verstappen sends warning to Mercedes in race simulations as Ferrari waits Don’t miss GPblog in Google Mark us as a preferred source and our articles will appear more often at the top of Top Stories.

evidence.title: FIA delivers fresh update on conditions at rain-hit Sepang circuit
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The FIA has provided an update on the weather conditions expected over the coming minutes, but for now there is little positive news regarding the start of the Bahrain Grand P FIA delivers new Bahrain GP weather update, and it’s not good news Breaking News 09:08, 04 Oct 0 Comments Tobia Elia Tobia is a Formula 1 journalist at GPblog with experience at international circuits. [e003:f02] Since 2022, he has covered Grands Prix across Europe, delivering reliable coverage and insights from the paddock. [e003:f03] Shortly before the scheduled start, the FIA officially confirmed that the Bahrain Grand Prix would be delayed due to the heavy rain that had swept across the Sepang International Circuit. [e003:f04] The downpour intensified in the build-up to the race, leaving significant amounts of water on parts of the track and making conditions unsuitable for the Grand Prix to begin as planned. [e003:f05] Race Control has confirmed that the rain has remained steady over the past 10 minutes, with no improvement expected in the immediate future. [e003:f06] The Medical Car was subsequently sent out to assess the circuit and determine whether conditions were suitable for the race to begin. [e003:f07] After completing several laps at Sepang, the Medical Car reported significant amounts of standing water around the track. [e003:f08] As a result, conditions are currently considered unsuitable for the Bahrain Grand Prix to get underway. [e003:f09] Follow the Bahrain GP in Malaysia LIVE here ! evidence.title: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e006:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e006:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e006:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e006:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e006:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e006:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e006:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e006:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e006:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e006:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

evidence.title: トランプの超知能協定、Anthropicが2兆ドルIPOを申請、Starshipが軌道到達 | EP #298｜Peter Diamandis
evidence.body: [e001:f01] フロンティアラボの安全性に関する言説は、規制と責任回避の両方の役割を果たしているとの結論に。 [e001:f02] 143分の会話の大部分は、AnthropicのIPO申請、OpenAIのDev Day、AMDによるWorld Labs買収、Starship初の軌道飛行、そしてAIの道徳性と責任をめぐる締めくくりの2本のストーリーに充てられている。 [e001:f03] ホストのPeter Diamandis、Alexander Wissner-Gross、Salim Ismail、Dave Blundinは、ホワイトハウスの「超知能協定」を、拘束力のある安全枠組みというより、より厳しい規制を先回りして骨抜きにする芝居として扱っており、Anthropicの5000億ドル規模の計算資源コミットメントが防衛可能な賭けなのか債務爆弾なのかについても、意見が鋭く割れている。 [e001:f04] Anthropicは時価総額2兆ドルを目標とするS1を提出し、2025年の売上は45.9億ドル、営業損失は80億ドル、そして大部分がキャンセル不能な約5000億ドルのクラウドコミットメントを抱えている。 [e001:f05] OpenAIはDev Dayで20以上の製品を発表する一方、内部安全性テストを理由に旗艦モデルGPT-6.1 Astraを廃止した。 [e001:f06] ホストたちはまた、Anthropicが宗教学者と非公開会合を持ったことを受けてAIの道徳的地位を議論し、FTC委員長Andrew Fergusonの「企業はエージェントが独自に行動したと主張して責任を逃れることはできない」という発言も取り上げている。 [e001:f07] ホワイトハウス協定は、より厳しい規制を先回りする自主規制である 20人近いテックリーダーがトランプ大統領およびマイク・ジョンソン下院議長とともにイーストルームでの昼食会に参加し、ホワイトハウスは4層構造の「超知能協定」に署名した。 [e001:f08] Blundinは、Metaが8月に子どもの依存症と危害をめぐり180億ドルの和解に合意したことに言及し、協定の内部統制と監査の層が、同様の法理論の下でエージェントの不正行為に対する責任リスクを軽減できる可能性があると指摘する。 [e001:f09] AnthropicのIPO申請は2兆ドル目標と5000億ドルのコミットメントを組み合わせる AnthropicはS1を提出した。 [e001:f10] 2025年の売上は45.9億ドルで前年比12倍、計算インフラによる営業損失は80億ドル、現金は200億ドル、そして将来のクラウドおよびインフラコミットメントは約5000億ドルで、その大部分はキャンセル不能である。 [e001:f11] Fortuneは2026年第2四半期だけで売上が115億ドルだったと報じている。 [e001:f12] 指標 数値 2025年売上 45.9億ドル、前年比12倍 営業損失 80億ドル（計算インフラ） 貸借対照表上の現金 200億ドル 将来の計算資源コミットメント 約5000億ドル、大部分キャンセル不能 2026年第2四半期売上（Fortune） 115億ドル 目標IPO時価総額 2兆ドル リスク開示ページ数 261ページ中80ページ ガバナンス：共同創業者らは創業者LLCを通じて特別議決権株式を保有し、公開株主から安全性ミッションを守る構造となっている。 [e001:f13] 彼はAnthropicを「素晴らしいビジネス」と呼ぶ一方で、オープンウェイトモデルとモデルの満足化によって「2年で粉砕される」と述べ、売上の85%がAPIベースであること、そしてOpus 5.5の方が効率的になったため自身のClaude Maxプランの利用をやめたことに言及する。 [e001:f14] Wissner-GrossはGPT-6.1 Solのベンチマークを蒸留のステップと読み、タスクあたりコスト曲線が有利に動いていると述べ、OpenAIがAnthropicの姿勢——大型で高価なモデルをリリースし、その後に急速に安価な蒸留版を出す——を採用したと指摘する。 [e001:f15] Ship 41は上昇中にRaptorエンジン1基を失ったが軌道燃焼を完了し、2周回してハワイ近郊の北太平洋に軟着陸した。 [e001:f16] AnthropicがClaudeの道徳的地位について宗教学者に諮問 New York Timesは、Anthropicがカトリック、ギリシャ正教、ユダヤ教、ヒンドゥー教、モルモン教、アフリカ先住民の宗教から宗教学者を招いた非公開会合を開き、Claudeが善悪をどう推論するかを形成しようとしたと報じた。

evidence.title: SpaceX Starship Is Orbital: Here's What It Means for Investors
evidence.body: [e002:f01] It's official now: Space Exploration Technologies ( SPCX +7.36% ) has an orbital-class Starship launch system -- and it'll almost certainly be ready to take over when the Falcon 9 retires. [e002:f02] For months, SpaceX has been signaling plans to retire the Falcon 9 reusable rocket. [e002:f03] This rocket is the workhorse of its space fleet, carrying more than 99% of SpaceX payloads to orbit. [e002:f04] Replacing both of these pieces of space hardware will be the Super Heavy booster and the Starship spacecraft, which SpaceX collectively (and confusingly) refers to simply as "Starship." SpaceX's plan got its latest green light on Monday, Sept. [e002:f05] 28, when the company launched Starship Flight 14 at 8:48 a.m. [e002:f06] Eighteen minutes and 20 seconds later, SpaceX mission control gave the go-ahead for the Starship to relight one engine and accelerate the spacecraft to orbital speed. [e002:f07] In SpaceX's first non-demonstration revenue-generating Starship launch , Flight 14 deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites for SpaceX's Starlink constellation. [e002:f08] SpaceX cut the flight short after completing one orbit, landing the spacecraft in the Pacific just three hours and eight minutes after launch. [e002:f09] Indeed, one team of companies building a replacement for the International Space Station ( Starlab ) has confirmed it has hired SpaceX to launch its entire space station to orbit in a single Starship. [e002:f10] Its 100-ton payload to Low Earth Orbit will also enable Starship to carry many more satellites into orbit for SpaceX's launch customers -- about four times more payload per launch than the Falcon 9 could handle. [e002:f11] I've previously estimated the internal cost of a partially reusable Falcon 9 launch at about $12 million, implying the company may be earning as much as an 84% gross profit margin on its launches. (That's the difference between what it costs SpaceX to launch, versus the price it charges its customers.) A fully reusable Starship will significantly change these economics. [e002:f12] Furthermore, we know at least one early launch customer is paying $90 million for a Starship mission . [e002:f13] That may be only the starting point. $90 million is already a low price relative to what launch providers such as Arianespace and United Launch Alliance charge -- and Starship can carry three to four times the payload of those other companies' rockets. [e002:f14] Assuming comparable per-kilogram launch costs, SpaceX should theoretically have room to charge $300 million to $400 million per Starship launch before worrying about price competition. [e002:f15] Although he's nearly as famous for his exaggerations as for his rockets, Elon Musk has publicly predicted that within three years, SpaceX Starships will launch once per hour around the world: It will get really nutty when Starship is launching every hour in 3 years -- Elon Musk (@elonmusk) Feb. [e002:f16] 19, 2026 Multiply 24 hours per day times 365 days per year times even just $90 million per launch, and Starship revenue could theoretically reach $788.4 trillion (that's $788,400,000,000) annually.

evidence.title: SpaceX launches 4 astronauts on record-fast trip to ISS
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The astronauts will join Expedition 75 for a long-duration science mission. [e004:f02] SpaceX launched four astronauts toward the International Space Station on Thursday, beginning a six-month mission that could produce the fastest U.S. trip to the orbiting laboratory in its history. [e004:f03] NASA astronaut Jessica Watkins commanded the Crew-13 mission, which lifted off aboard a Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida after a three-week delay to repair the Dragon capsule’s leaking fuel system. [e004:f04] Watkins became the first Black woman to lead a crew to orbit. [e004:f05] A geologist who once worked with NASA’s Curiosity Mars rover team, she is making her second trip to the space station after spending 170 days there in 2022. [e004:f06] She was joined by NASA astronaut Luke Delaney, Canadian Space Agency astronaut Joshua Kutryk and Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov. [e004:f07] All three are first-time space fliers. [e004:f08] The crew will replace four astronauts who have been living and working aboard the station since February. [e004:f09] Dragon, named Grace, is expected to arrive at the space station at about 7 p.m. [e004:f10] EDT, less than eight hours after liftoff. [e004:f11] NASA says the planned 7-hour, 50-minute flight would be the fastest trip to the station by a U.S. spacecraft. [e004:f12] Their work includes research using human stem-cell-derived tissues to improve treatments and testing for heart disease and Parkinson’s disease, as well as studies of crop production, blood-flow changes in space and new equipment to monitor astronauts’ health. [e004:f13] “We feel like some of the luckiest people in the world,” Kutryk said before launch. [e004:f14] Kutryk’s wife, Heather, is due to give birth to the couple’s third child in late November, making him the fourth man to become a father while orbiting Earth. [e004:f15] The crew’s “Lucky 13” designation and mission patch pay tribute to Apollo 13, the 1970 moon mission that suffered a near-disastrous in-flight failure but returned its astronauts safely to Earth. [e004:f16] Watkins said the crew wanted to honor Apollo 13’s “resilience and their grit.”。

evidence.title: This Company Created an In-Car Signal Booster for SpaceX's Starlink Mobile
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Utah-based Wilson Connectivity's weBoost Sky fits on a car and helps signals from SpaceX's direct-to-cell service reach phones inside the vehicle. [e001:f02] SpaceX’s satellite-to-phone service, Starlink Mobile , is getting its own third-party accessory for use inside a car. [e001:f03] Currently, Starlink Mobile is exclusive to T-Mobile in the US as T-Satellite, providing phone access in cellular dead zones, such as remote or rural areas. [e001:f04] But the service can struggle to send signals to phones sitting inside a vehicle, which is where Utah-based Wilson Connectivity's weBoost Sky signal booster comes in. [e001:f05] No modification or extra hardware is required for the weBoost Sky, described as "the world’s first vehicle signal booster engineered specifically to strengthen satellite direct-to-device connectivity." There's a roof-mounted antenna and a long cable that runs through the vehicle to connect to an “in-cabin antenna,” which relays the signal to a T-Satellite-enabled phone. For power, the antenna system connects to a USB-C port; a cigarette lighter adapter is included. [e001:f07] The weBoost Sky is specifically designed for the radio bands used by T-Satellite. [e001:f08] This week, the company began marketing the $149.99 product to customers who frequently drive in cellular dead zones. [e001:f09] T-Satellite supports mobile data to both Apple and Google Maps, along with a select group of other apps, including WhatsApp, X, and Messenger. (Credit: Wilson Connectivity ) Wilson Connectivity has published a 4-page report on its field tests showing that the antenna can improve signal quality, reducing delays in satellite text messages. [e001:f10] In one anecdote, the company noted that the weBoost Sky produced four signal bars on the phone, which dropped to none when the antenna was turned off. [e001:f11] T-Satellite is free for customers on the carrier’s premium plans; otherwise, it's $10 per month. [e001:f12] There are signs that T-Mobile is considering alternative satellite providers, as SpaceX has signaled it could use Starlink Mobile to compete with the big three carriers in the US. [e001:f13] If or how this could impact weBoost Sky is unclear.

evidence.title: Starlink launches Communities Program for passive income through internet sharing
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Under the Starlink for Communities program , a host installs one dish and router setup in a location with nearby demand: an apartment complex, campground, rural crossroads, or event site. [e002:f02] Neighbors or local users can buy short-term passes rather than full individual subscriptions, giving the Starlink provider a potential path to passive income. [e002:f03] SpaceX is introducing a new @Starlink for Communities program that lets you earn money by providing Starlink internet to your neighbors or people nearby, who can pay for access by the hour, day, week, or month. [e002:f04] Neighbors pay for the access they need, while the person… — Sawyer Merritt (@SawyerMerritt) October 1, 2026 Advertisement - The model echoes the passive-income vision long attached to Tesla’s Robotaxi plans , and it seems like it’s something Musk has hinted toward in the past as he believes AI will make the need to work relatively optional. [e002:f05] The company currently operates a limited company-controlled robotaxi service in select areas and has solicited interest from fleet buyers for Cybercab vehicles , while private Full Self-Driving owners have not yet been able to dispatch their own cars for paid rides at scale. [e002:f06] Advertisement - Tesla primes Cybercabs for 4K streaming and high bandwidth gaming with Starlink integration Starlink is a satellite broadband service operated by SpaceX that uses a constellation of low-Earth-orbit satellites to deliver internet to locations where terrestrial broadband is slow, expensive, or absent. [e002:f07] The Communities program extends that reach by letting hosts resell short bursts of capacity to people nearby, while also providing high-speed internet access to those who are simply around a Starlink user. [e002:f08] Related Topics: Featured SpaceX Starlink Starlink Communities Joey Klender Joey has been a journalist covering electric mobility at TESLARATI since August 2019. [e002:f09] If you're looking for great Tesla accessories, check out Advertisement Comments News Tesla just made its headlights even better through a software update Published 12 hours ago on October 3, 2026 By Joey Klender Credit: @jojje167 on X Tesla just upgraded its headlights through a software update, making them even better without any physical or hardware upgrade. [e002:f10] Tesla’s latest software update is quietly improving nighttime driving for a small number of owners. [e002:f11] Model 3 gets Dynamic Headlight Leveling — low beams auto-aim around traffic for max visibility, less glare. [e002:f12] Early indications reveal the update is reaching a limited set of vehicles, including certain Model 3 and Cybertruck examples in the United States and the United Arab Emirates. [e002:f13] Some earlier Model 3 and Model Y vehicles were the subject of an NHTSA recall related to excessive low-beam glare ; the software adjustment offers a potential mitigation for cars equipped with the necessary leveling hardware. [e002:f14] Advertisement - For drivers who have received the update, the system requires no new settings or user input. [e002:f15] As the feature reaches more vehicles, it adds another example of Tesla using over-the-air software to refine existing hardware rather than waiting for a new model year. [e002:f16] Published 23 hours ago on October 2, 2026 By Gene Tesla has started teasing a Halloween software update for its vehicles, with a short clip on X that reads, “Halloween is coming.” The clip opens on a glowing pumpkin before pulling back to the car’s center touchscreen, where the usual parked visualization has been replaced by a graveyard scene, and the vehicle draped with a white sheet so it reads as a cartoon ghost.

[e003:f04] The airline still plans to equip all 300 of its aircraft by March 2028. [e003:f05] Now, per a report from JonNYC , American appears to be weighing Starlink for its Boeing 737, 777, and 787 fleets as well. [e003:f06] If accurate, it would finally bring fast connectivity to long-haul international flights, where it’s a glaring gap today. » Related: Delta CEO Rejects Starlink, American and United Offer Status Matches to Unhappy Flyers JetBlue Adds Barranquilla, Colombia JetBlue launched new daily nonstop service between Fort Lauderdale (FLL) and Barranquilla (BAQ) on October 1. [e003:f07] Barranquilla joins Medellín and Cartagena in JetBlue’s Colombian network, with Cali (CLO) set to follow later this month for 4 planned destinations in all . [e003:f08] To mark the launch, JetBlue is offering one-way fares from $134 in Main and $234 in EvenMore. [e003:f09] Advertisement KLM Receives Its First A350 KLM received its first Airbus A350 this week , a -900 model that will operate its first route between Amsterdam (AMS) and Toronto (YYZ). [e003:f10] Other planned destinations include Montreal (YUL), Nairobi (NBO), and the Tanzanian triangle of Dar es Salaam (DAR), Zanzibar (ZNZ), and Kilimanjaro (JRO). [e003:f11] Air India’s consolidated net loss widened to around INR 22,238 (about $2.3 billion) in FY2026, up from roughly INR 10,859 the year before, and the airline is operating under heavy scrutiny after the June 2025 AI171 crash. [e003:f12] FAA Pushes on Hiring and Modernization The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) says it exceeded its FY2026 goal, hiring 2,235 air traffic controller trainees, its most ever . [e003:f13] A gamer-focused recruiting campaign drew more than 12,000 applicants in 24 hours, and the agency is on track to hire at least 8,900 through 2028. [e003:f14] Advertisement Separately, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and Senator Eric Schmitt are pushing the Modern Skies Act , a proposed $30 billion investment to modernize air traffic contro l, replace aging infrastructure, and upgrade airports, building on $12.5 billion already committed. [e003:f15] Other Airline News Delta is building its own advertising and media network , hiring a former Deloitte and Digitas leader to run it, following United’s move into the space. [e003:f16] Final Thoughts From new planes and new routes to internet updates and announcements from governments in the U.S. and the U.K., there was quite a spectrum of announcements this week across aviation.
